role: SHIPPED, and the largest single recall gain in this lane. Supersedes V6 and V8.

defect.statement: Every SQL statement inside a plpgsql body failed to parse, so a body contributed SYMBOLS but ZERO RELATIONSHIPS.

measured.input: DO $$ BEGIN SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies; END $$;
DO $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO t VALUES (1); END $$;

defect.cause: Mine. plpgsql_block and every control structure repeated _plpgsql_statement, which DELIBERATELY excludes $.statement; the rule that wraps $.statement with its ';' was used only at the body's top level. So a procedural block could hold procedural forms and nothing else.
defect.alsoCorrectsAnEarlierClaim: The recall gains reported for V6 and V8 came from files parsing FURTHER — the declaration sweep and resync reaching more nodes — not from reading the SQL inside bodies. That was not the mechanism described at the time.

whyTheFixNeededAPair.problem: Parsing alone measured WORSE. A body the scaffolding could not satisfy failed the rule and took the DECLARATION with it: postgis_topology fell from 34 function symbols to 2, and postgis_raster from 422 to 234, while the EXECUTE-literal pass was identical under both (122 literals found, 2 recovered) — which located the loss precisely.
whyTheFixNeededAPair.solution: Pair the structured forms with an OPAQUE-BODY FALLBACK. This is the opposite of V3 and the difference is the whole point: V3 made the opaque form the ONLY body and was rejected for collapsing 49 files by up to 95.8%. Here the structured forms come first, and the external scanner emits the opaque token only when the start tag is not a valid symbol, i.e. only when the structured form is unavailable. A body the scaffolding can read is read in full; one it cannot degrades to a token instead of taking its declaration with it.

measuredOutcome.instrument: a SELF-VERIFYING probe: it asserts the analyzer's grammar handoff landed and the engine's temp wasm is refreshed before it reports a number, because the engine resolves the wasm through a temp copy and hands the analyzer its grammar asynchronously

gates.mutants: 13/13 caught, 0 survivors (1 retired with its reason)
gates.pinContract: sql lane re-pinned to the V11 bytes

residualGaps: One differential false positive: rel:Queries.sql:uses:global:recent_users, the CTE-alias class, appearing only in file context while the identical query inline is clean. The deep walk can reach a top-level statement after a later one has cleared the CTE scope; refreshing at dispatch time fixes nothing measurable and costs a contract case, so it was reverted.
PERFORM 1 FROM t does not parse: plpgsql's PERFORM takes a full query and the shipped rule accepts only an expression. PERFORM my_func(1) parses.
@placeholder@ templating (154 extension files) is unaddressed and needs a template token in identifier and type positions.
282 of 387 extension files still contain at least one ERROR.
Structurally unreachable, not a defect: 93 function names and 1,358 declarations whose identifiers are composed at run time inside EXECUTE fragments, and 63 edges to PostgreSQL's own catalogs.
